fires.name: 1924_FIRE
fires.model_caveat: 24-hour q65 front-reach forecast trained on 79 historical GeoMAC fires. The strictly causal day guard FAILED the quiet-day acceptance envelope and that failure stands: on the 2026-09-07 live batch this runtime predicted exactly zero growth on 4 of 11 active fires, because reach is decoded only where the segment gate is open and the day guard holds the gate shut below its 0.39 threshold. A published zero is a guard decision, not a measurement that the fire will not move. The displayed hourly contours are constant-local-rate interpolation of a model trained on 24-hour endpoints; they are spatially validated but have no independently observed sub-daily timing labels. Detached spotting is not represented, and the seven-fire audit behind the validation numbers was not blind because those fires had been reviewed in prior experiments.
